headline: Long-read simulators and pipelines are benchmarked against real sequencing data
label: Sequencing Analysis Tool Benchmarking
summary: Nanopore surveillance at continental scale and new read-level benchmarks make simulator and pipeline validation against real reads increasingly urgent.
synthesis: The common thread is validation and deployment of computational tools for sequence-based genomics, spanning read simulation, pathogen pipelines, and inference. Long-read simulators are benchmarked against R10.4.1 Oxford Nanopore WGS reads, with PBSIM3 best matching read-level metrics while no tool captures the full error profile. MucOneUp generates MUC1-VNTR reference sequences with targeted frameshift variants and simulated Illumina, Nanopore, and PacBio reads for benchmarking. HaploDetox reconstructs de novo bacterial haplotypes from short reads using a de Bruijn graph labelled by a negative binomial mixture model and conditional random fields. MeaSeq provides an open-source pipeline for measles WGS from Illumina or Nanopore data. A modular Bayesian framework infers directed transmission networks from polyclonal P. falciparum infections via Plasmotrack. A published study pairs rapid nanopore sequencing with an offline dashboard and a novel variant caller across six African countries.
